templates.source: https://knowledge.bolintechnology.com/ex1030huserguide — Bolin EX1030H User Guide, Streaming Server Connection Strings: RTSP port 554, rtsp://<username>:<password>@<IP address>:<RTSP port>/media/video<1/2> (same string in the EXU230H, EXU230NX, EX1030NX, SD530H/SD530NX, D2-210H/D2-220H and R9-L420N user guides and the RANGE / R9-L420N datasheets)
https://knowledge.bolintechnology.com/r9l420n — Bolin R9-L420N User Guide: RTSP rtsp://<camera-IP>:<port>/media/video1 for Main Stream; /media/video2 for Sub Stream, port 554

notes: Current Bolin PTZ firmware (EX/EXU outdoor, SD530H/NX, D2 Dante AV-H, R9, RANGE) serves RTSP on port 554 at /media/video1 (main) and /media/video2 (sub); authentication is disabled by default and credentials may be put in the URL. The B2/B6/B7/N2/N6/N7 and R9 user guides say to copy the exact URL from the web UI's RTSP tab. Legacy lines use other paths and carry their own per-camera URL: BC-7, BC-9, B9-418, EX1030SHD-B-LSN2P1 and SD530SHD-B-RSN2PW use /PSIA/Streaming/channels/0 (main) and /1 (sub) (https://knowledge.bolintechnology.com/bc7part2, https://knowledge.bolintechnology.com/b9418userguide); the D412/D220 Dante AV Ultra and VCC-M2 use /stream/main and /stream/sub (https://knowledge.bolintechnology.com/d412partthree, https://knowledge.bolintechnology.com/vccm2part2).
